name: device-discovery
description: Discover network devices using extensible protocol-specific discoverers.

commands.title: Device Discovery: Scan for Crestron Devices
Device Discovery: Scan for All Devices

deviceDiscovery.scanDuration.description: How long to listen for discovery responses, in seconds. Applies to all discoverers. Results appear as they arrive.

deviceDiscovery.defaultAdapter.description: Name of the default network adapter (for example, en0 on macOS). The current IPv4 address is resolved each scan. Leave empty to choose when scanning. Use Device Discovery: Select Adapter to pick an adapter and optionally save it. If the adapter is unavailable, you will be asked to select another.

deviceDiscovery.discoverers.crestron.ena.description: Include the Crestron discoverer in Scan for All Devices. The Scan for Crestron Devices command remains available when unchecked.
